# MetroPT-3 bounded test fixture

This fixture contains the header and first three data rows from **MetroPT-3
Dataset**, distributed by the UCI Machine Learning Repository.

- Creators: Narjes Davari, Bruno Veloso, Rita Ribeiro, and Joao Gama
- DOI: <https://doi.org/10.24432/C5VW3R>
- UCI source: <https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/791/metropt%203%20dataset>
- License: CC BY 4.0
- Full distributed CSV SHA-256:
  `db30ccb4ea402e3c8bf2c99db06e288d4f2a772f6928f9dbe26a920d69793e24`

The repository fixture is a three-row subset and has its own checksum. It is
not the full source artifact and must not use the full-file checksum as its
identity.
